items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, no administrator privileges, and no user interaction, enabling an attacker to switch customer sessions.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution. This issue has a CVSS score of 8.7.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This critical Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. It carries a CVSS score of 7.7.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to a security feature bypass. A low-privileged attacker could gain unauthorized read and write access.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (B2B)
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability specifically affects Adobe Commerce B2B, allowing for a security feature bypass. It has a CVSS score of 7.5.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An important (high severity) incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in a security feature bypass. This issue has a CVSS score of 6.8.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: APSB26-73 addresses several critical vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-34645, CVE-2026-34646, CVE-2026-34656, CVE-2026-34647, CVE-2026-34648, CVE-2026-34649, CVE-2026-34650, CVE-2026-34651, CVE-2026-34652, CVE-2026-34653, CVE-2026-34654, CVE-2026-34655, CVE-2026-34658, CVE-2026-34685, and CVE-2026-34686, which can lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Sansec reported a massive security release for Amasty extensions, identifying two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution in Magento and Adobe Commerce stores.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
